description: A campaign's characters, PCs and NPCs, for the Micro-UIs of the campaign system: each with its id, its name, its aliases, its kind (pj or pnj), the player of a PC (null for an NPC), its type, description, prompt, background and behaviour, its stats (FOR, DEX, CON, INT, SAG, CHA), its armour class, its maximum hit points, its speed, its features, its look (art, colour, initials, portrait, crop, token name, illustration), its notes and its D&D Beyond link when it has one. It is read by reference only from the campaign system's own Micro-UIs (contract D, gate system-frontier). A Micro-UI of another system (session, table, live) does not need it; it reads the characters through a Capability of its own system.
output: { id: string, name: string, aliases: string[], kind: 'pj' | 'pnj', player: string | null, type: string, description: string, prompt: string, background: string, behavior: string, stats: { FOR: number, DEX: number, CON: number, INT: number, SAG: number, CHA: number }, ca: number, pvMax: number, speed: string, features: { name: string, text: string }[], art: string | null, color: string, initials: string, portrait: boolean, crop?: { zoom: number, x: number, y: number }, tokenName?: string, illustration?: string | null, notes: string, ddb?: { url: string, syncedAt: string } }[]
